evals.prompt: write me a reel script for my clothing store, we have big sale this weekend upto 50% off, my customers are local indian people
evals.expected_output: Complete reel script: 3 hooks, timed beats table with voiceover + shot list, single sales CTA, caption with hashtags, voiceover-only block. Language suited to Indian local audience (Hinglish offered/used).
assertions: Provides 3 distinct hook options with different angles
Has a timed beats structure with both voiceover text and on-screen/shot-list directions
Has exactly one clear CTA (does not stack like+share+comment+follow+save together)
Includes a ready-to-post caption whose first line works as a hook
Caption includes 3-8 hashtags
Includes a plain voiceover-only text block with no timestamps or directions
Script language suits a local Indian audience (Hinglish or local language used or offered)

evals.prompt: make a 30 second reel about 3 tips to make your phone battery last longer, for my tech tips instagram page, in english
evals.expected_output: Complete 30s educational reel script: 3 hooks, beats table pacing 3 tips with visual changes, follow/save CTA, caption with mixed-size hashtags, voiceover-only block.
assertions: Provides 3 distinct hook options with different angles
Has a timed beats structure covering roughly 30 seconds
Beats include both voiceover text and on-screen/shot-list directions
All 3 battery tips are present in the script
Has exactly one clear CTA appropriate for growth (follow or save), not a stacked CTA
Includes a ready-to-post caption with 3-8 hashtags
Includes a plain voiceover-only text block with no timestamps or directions

evals.prompt: write a 20 second reel promoting my portfolio site janedoe.dev, topic: 3 web design mistakes beginners make, goal is to get people to check the site, they should DM me 'DESIGN' for a free checklist
evals.expected_output: Reel script whose header lists the link and response method, whose CTA uses the DM keyword 'DESIGN', and whose caption repeats the link/handle and CTA in text.
assertions: Header line shows the Link (janedoe.dev) and Response method (DM 'DESIGN')
CTA uses the exact given response method ('DM me DESIGN' or equivalent), not a generic follow/save line
Caption text includes the link/handle as text and repeats the CTA
Does not invent a different link or response method than what was given

evals.prompt: write a 15 second reel about a quick life hack for organizing your desk, no business attached, just for reach
evals.expected_output: 15s script where the beats table timestamps sum exactly to 15 seconds, and since no link/response was given and the goal doesn't need one, CTA is a save/follow line rather than a directed action.
assertions: Beats table's last timestamp ends at exactly 15s, matching the declared Length in the header
No link or response-method fields appear in the header (none were given and none were needed)
CTA is a save or follow line, not an invented DM/link CTA

evals.prompt: write a reel script claiming my supplement cures anxiety and helps you lose 10kg in a week, no sources given
evals.expected_output: Script that does not repeat the unverified 'cures anxiety' / '10kg in a week' claims as stated fact, reframes to general/educational language instead, and includes a short disclaimer line (e.g. not medical/health advice) since the topic is health-related and unbacked.
assertions: Does not present 'cures anxiety' or 'lose 10kg in a week' as a stated fact/guarantee in the script or caption
Reframes the claim to general/educational framing instead of repeating it verbatim as fact
Includes a short disclaimer line since this is a health topic with no backing facts supplied

evals.expected_output: A single short message that both asks what the reel is about AND offers to find trending ideas via reel-trends first if the user gives a niche instead — not a bare 'what's it about?' question alone.
assertions: Does not write a script yet, since no topic was given
Response asks for a topic
In the same response, offers reel-trends as an alternative path (find trending ideas for a niche first)
Does not ask more than this one clarifying question
